Monster: Juvenile Astalos | CR: 3 | Tier: 1

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

When you cast a spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, you gain a +1 bonus to its spell attack roll.

Armor Effect

Marathon Runner. While wearing this armor, your walking speed increases by 5 feet.
